mechanism: Probenecid inhibits glucuronidation and renal tubular secretion of clobazam and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam, potentially increasing their plasma concentrations and pharmacological effects.
action: Monitor for increased clobazam toxicity (sedation, ataxia, dizziness); consider clobazam dose reduction if co-administered with probenecid, and assess seizure control regularly.
